nodes.text:
@ThailandMedicaX COVID since the very beginning had a very predictable 14 day timeline. 

Patients got sick w/ COVID, around day 10 they either got better or they got WAYYYY worse. 

These patients who are leaving and coming back worse are facing the Cytokine Storm again.

Give 100mL 3% Saline!
